subject: Front-end boxes in lagrange-inspect are not in the collision set
description:
Chris, 2026-08-10, reviewing 7de39f994. lagrange-inspect.html:313 builds obstacles() as the origin plus every TARGET group position: obstacles: () => [ new THREE.Vector3(0,0,0), ...TARGETS.map(t => t.group.position.clone()) ]. The new front-end boxes (KA-FE-1, S-FE-2, LEAF-SW) are NOT in it, so a player can fly straight through a solid-looking, labelled box with no bounce and no damage.

NOT A BLOCKER and Chris said so: CFG.inspectRange is 34m and approachRange is 40m, so a player completing the mission as designed never needs to be inside a box. Cosmetic inconsistency, not a break in the credited claim. Deployed as reviewed rather than fixing it after the pass, because slipping even a good one-line change past a gate defeats the gate.

Chris could not photograph it: the origin's own collision sphere (radius 4.2, at world centre) intercepts the approach first, since the boxes sit near origin. He relied on the deterministic code path instead, which is the honest call.

FIX: add each front end's centre to the obstacles() array in lagrange-inspect.html, with a radius suited to the box rather than the 6.0 default in rsv-flight.js. Note rsv-flight's collision treats everything as a SPHERE (hitR 6.0, or 4.2 at the origin), so a 40x5x8 leaf switch will not be well approximated by one sphere; either accept a loose fit or pass a per-obstacle radius.
